# Hasan Ovi — init_ovi

> Personal site of Hasan Ovi (init_ovi), a hobby programmer who builds small
> things for the web: browser games, developer tools, CSS libraries, and the
> occasional blog post. Mainly Node.js and Python.

This is a static site hosted on GitHub Pages. The project and blog lists are
stored as JSON and also baked into the homepage HTML at build time, so the
full content is readable without JavaScript. The JSON files below remain the
authoritative, machine-readable source of truth — prefer them over scraping
the rendered pages.

Projects span CSS and animation libraries, CLI and terminal tools,
anime-themed desktop and web apps, and small browser games.

## Projects

- [projects.json](https://iamovi.github.io/projects.json): All projects as JSON. Each entry has `name`, `url` (the live or GitHub link), `description`, and `date`.
- [Homepage — projects section](https://iamovi.github.io/): Renders the list above, paginated three per page.
- [GitHub profile](https://github.com/iamovi): Source code for every project.

## Blog

- [blog.json](https://iamovi.github.io/blog.json): All posts as JSON. Each entry has `title`, `slug`, `date`, `tag`, `excerpt`, plus `published` (ISO date), `date_full`, `subtitle` and `description` used to build the post page.
- [feed.xml](https://iamovi.github.io/feed.xml): RSS feed of the same posts.

Each post has a page at `https://iamovi.github.io/blog/<slug>/`, where `<slug>` is
the `slug` field from blog.json. These post pages are static HTML and fully
readable without JavaScript. The homepage also lists the same posts.

- [My First Website](https://iamovi.github.io/blog/my-first-website/): The story of the first site, created August 2021. `slug`: `my-first-website`.

## Games

- [Game House](https://iamovi.github.io/games/): Index of the browser games.

Each game has a page at `https://iamovi.github.io/games/<name>/`.

- [Snake](https://iamovi.github.io/games/snake/): Steer the snake, eat the fruit, and grow. Edges wrap around; your own tail ends the run.
- [Flappy](https://iamovi.github.io/games/flappy/): One button, endless pipes. Tap to flap and chase your best.
- [Waifu or Not?](https://iamovi.github.io/games/waifu-or-not/): Swipe left or right and decide. Ten rounds, one verdict.
- [Memory Match](https://iamovi.github.io/games/memory-match/): Flip two cards and hunt for pairs. Clear the board in as few moves as you can.

## Chat

- [chatguys](https://iamovi.github.io/chatguys/): A public, temporary chat room. Messages are cleared automatically after one week.

## Optional

- [sitemap.xml](https://iamovi.github.io/sitemap.xml): All indexable pages.
- [robots.txt](https://iamovi.github.io/robots.txt): Crawling rules. `/admin/` is disallowed.
- [X / Twitter](https://x.com/iamhasanovi): @iamhasanovi
